name: Medical University of Warsaw
summary: Warsaw medical university whose Faculty of Medicine teaches in five hospitals; a six-year MD and a five-year dentistry degree taught in English.

handoff.label: Studies in English at WUM (MD and dentistry)

ib.text: IB holders sit WUM's online competency test (80% of the ranking); IB Biology and Chemistry at HL plus Physics or Maths make up the other 20%. The IB Diploma counts as proof of English.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year, 384-ECTS medical degree: anatomy and the scientific basis of medicine, pre-clinical and behavioural subjects, then surgical and non-surgical clinical classes from year four, with 20 weeks of summer clerkships.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry at HL plus Physics or Maths are required, and you sit WUM's online competency test in biology, chemistry and decision making.

needs.note: IB 7 = 100 points. If missing, WUM's own Biology exam (pass at 30%) can stand in.
IB 7 = 100 points. If missing, WUM's own Chemistry exam (pass at 30%) can stand in.
SL is accepted but scored with a lower multiplier than HL.

programmes.selectionNote: Online competency test (80 questions) counts 80%, IB Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Maths 20%; the top of the ranking get offers. 170 places in 2026.

lastYear.text: register by 30 June; online tests 28 March–5 July

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year, 300-ECTS dental degree built to EU standards: basic sciences first, then from year three treating your own patients under supervision at the University Dental Center on the Banacha campus, with four-week summer placements.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry at HL plus Physics or Maths are required, and you sit WUM's online competency test or submit an accepted UCAT, BMAT, MCAT or DAT score.

needs.note: If missing, WUM's own Biology exam (pass at 30%) can stand in.
If missing, WUM's own Chemistry exam (pass at 30%) can stand in.
SL counts with a multiplier: Physics 0.6, Maths AA 0.6, Maths AI 0.5; HL counts in full.

programmes.selectionNote: Competency test (or an accepted admission-test score) counts 80%, IB Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Maths 20%. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: register by 23 June; online tests 9 May–5 July

notes: There is no EU rate: everyone pays tuition in euros, and a €1,000 confirmation fee, part of the first year's tuition, holds your place once you qualify.
Final-year students apply with predicted grades; the competency test is taken online from home, within set hours on the session weekend you choose.
UCAT, BMAT, MCAT or a science degree replace the competency test only for some international applicants: email the admissions office to confirm before you apply that way.
